source.description:
Observed twice during KAN-91 Phase 3: when the reviewer specialist runs 'bd show unitAI-gp7nq.4' from inside its sandbox (worktree + tmux + pi session), the dot in the bead id is being stripped before it reaches bd, producing 'bd show unitAI-gp7nq4' which fails with not-found. Workaround used: passed required evidence (smoke output, file paths) inline via 'sp resume' prompt instead of telling the reviewer to look up the bead. This is a procedural papercut — costs one fix-loop every time a dotted child bead reaches review.

## SCOPE
Investigation areas:
- pi session arg parsing / shell escaping for tools that invoke bd
- prompt rendering / template substitution layer (runner.ts / supervisor.ts) for bead_id interpolation
- whether the dot is stripped at prompt build, at tool invocation, or at bash exec layer
- reproduce by dispatching a reviewer against a dotted bead and observing the actual 'bd show' invocation in observability.db specialist_events tool entries

## SUCCESS
Reviewer (and all specialists) preserve dots in bead ids verbatim across the entire prompt → tool → exec pipeline. 'bd show unitAI-gp7nq.4' resolves correctly inside the reviewer sandbox.

## CONSTRAINTS
Memory key 'bead-id-verbatim-rule-added-to-prevent-bd' covers the orchestrator side. This bug is the sandbox/specialist side where the same rule needs to hold.

## VALIDATION
Dispatch reviewer against any dotted bead, then grep specialist_events.text_content for the actual 'bd show' command — must contain the dot.
